description: List all contacts in Xero. This includes Suppliers and Customers.

page.description: Optional page number to retrieve for pagination.       If not provided, the first page will be returned. If 100 contacts are returned,       call this tool again with the next page number.

searchTerm.description: Search parameter that performs a case-insensitive text search across the Name, FirstName, LastName, ContactNumber and EmailAddress fields

name: list-contacts
